name: Hanamatsuri Karin
source:
Despite being a university student, Karin is a popular model and idol. She often visits the cafe [url=/c11657]Isshu[/url] and [url=/c11653]Haya[/url] work at. She acts like a rich lady in front of her fans, she has a limousine, but she actually loves jokes, has a strong sense of justice and is very mature. Her nickname is Rikarin and she uses that name at work. She seems to have a close relationship with [url=/c91511]Kanata[/url], who happens to be a model as well.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memories_Off_~And_then~]Wikipedia[/url].]
